title: Verify the pipeline compiles
prompt: Implement `static bool GeneratedCatalogCompiles(string userSource)`: run the same catalog generator pattern as the checkpoint (attribute + GenCatalog class) but ALSO verify the OUTPUT compilation has zero error diagnostics (generated code included). Return false both when generation fails and when the generated source does not compile.

tests.name: end-to-end
tests.hint: Reuse the driver pattern; additionally run comp.GetDiagnostics() on the OUTPUT compilation.
